shared_elements: geometric net / crosshatch lattice pattern covering a zone
register of small repeated relief motifs (in A across the top, in B on the block at upper right)
justification: Both show pale stone carved with creature heads and a zone of crosshatched/net-like geometric patterning, and both include a splayed clawed or hand-like appendage, so the repertoire overlaps in a generic way. The decisive difference is mode and organisation: A is a flat slab covered in shallow, tightly ordered horizontal registers of profile animals and bands, while B is a bulbous, deeply undercut head sculpted nearly in the round with no register system at all.
